_comment: Frozen step-4 block-caller defaults. Blind: every value here was chosen
from the within-family permutation decoys, never from any curated RNA set.
Changing a value means re-running the decoy null, because the score floors
are empirical properties of that null and not transferable constants.

_rationale.reference_picker: Taking the longest windows gave three near-identical references and left diverged clade members with no hit at all, which is silent: they simply never contribute to recurrence. Spreading references across anchor-protein 5-mer diversity raised clade coverage from 29/43 to 38/43.
_rationale.k_references: Measured, not assumed. Past 3 the clade coverage falls (38 -> 37 -> 32 -> 30 at k=3,4,6,8) while the decoy rate climbs, because a reference set spanning the family's diversity also gives unrelated decoy members something to align to.
_rationale.min_recurrence: At 0.5 the real:decoy block ratio is ~6:1 and 29/43 real clades carry a block against 8/129 decoy clades. At 0.3 the decoy clade rate triples.
_rationale.score_floor: Empirical FDR is 0.062 at 0.80 and the decoy density is ~0 in four of five families. [PROVISIONAL: measured on the invalidated clade set.]
_rationale.high_confidence_floor: Zero decoy blocks at or above 0.90 in every family. [PROVISIONAL: measured on the invalidated clade set.]

_benchmark_only_note: Cas3 was flagged because its decoys cleared the floor at FDR 0.556 -- but that null is now known to have been degenerate (Cas3 had too few clades to draw decoys from, so decoys were largely redrawn from the clade they mirrored). The corrected run gives Cas3 6 clades, so the flag must be re-tested against a real null rather than carried over. PF18019 being a promiscuous HD domain remains a separate, independent reason for caution.
_PROVISIONAL: score_floor and high_confidence_floor below were derived from the 43-clade
null that the raw-anchor identity metric produced, and that clade set is
invalidated. They are retained only so the corrected run has a fixed
operating point to report against -- they are NOT yet properties of the
corrected null. Re-derive them from the corrected decoy distribution and
state in REPORT.md that they were re-derived; do not quote them as though
